{{2024–25 Atlantic 10 men's basketball standings}}
The '''2024–25 Saint Joseph's Hawks basketball team''' represented [[Saint Joseph's University]] during the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Hawks, led by sixth-year head coach [[Billy Lange]], played their home games at [[Hagan Arena]] in [[Philadelphia|Philadelphia, Pennsylvania]] as members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]].

== Previous season ==
The [[2023–24 Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball team|Hawks]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 21–14, 9–9 in [[2023–24 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in a three-way tie for seventh place.<ref>{{Cite web |title=2023-24 Men's Basketball Standings |url=http://atlantic10.com/standings.aspx?path=mbball |access-date=2024-08-09 |website=atlantic10.com |language=en}}</ref> As the No. 9 seed in the [[2024 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 Tournament]] they defeated [[2023–24 George Mason Patriots men's basketball team|George Mason]] and upset No. 1-seeded [[2023–24 Richmond Spiders men's basketball team|Richmond]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2023–24 VCU Rams men's basketball team|VCU]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-03-16 |title=Hawks Fall Short To VCU In A-10 Championship Semifinals, 66-60 |url=https://sjuhawks.com/news/2024/3/16/mens-basketball-hawks-fall-short-to-vcu-in-a-10-championship-semifinals-66-60.aspx |access-date=2024-08-09 |website=Saint Joseph's University |language=en}}</ref> The Hawks received a bid to the [[2024 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they lost to [[2023–24 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Seton Hall]] in the first round.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-03-20 |title=Men's Basketball Outlasted By Seton Hall In Overtime, 75-72 |url=https://sjuhawks.com/news/2024/3/20/mens-basketball-outlasted-by-seton-hall-in-overtime-75-72.aspx |access-date=2024-08-09 |website=Saint Joseph's University |language=en}}</ref>
